plugins.name: fsi-cloud-architect
plugins.description: Principal-level cloud architecture and platform enablement for financial services on Google Cloud (primary) and AWS. Covers hybrid and cross-cloud networking, GKE and Cloud Run platform standards, HA/DR tiers and tooling, GenAI platform with private inference and governance, FinOps and capex, M&A cloud integration, and FSI security and regulatory controls.
